note: Values REQUIRED by an external protocol/standard. Safe to hardcode inside a dedicated protocol-definition module only — never scattered inline.

forbidden_locations: business logic branching on a raw magic number without the named constant
entries.rationale: HTTP status codes are fixed by the HTTP standard; not configurable, not environment-dependent.
entries.validation_rule: value in [100-599] used as a response status, referenced by name not raw literal outside the constants module

entries.rationale: application/json is a fixed IANA-registered media type.

allowed_locations: service adapter's own protocol module, e.g. services/<provider>/oauth-paths.ts
entries.rationale: Path shape (/authorize, /token) is protocol-conventional; the HOST/domain portion is NOT — that must come from service-endpoint-registry.
entries.validation_rule: only the path segment is hardcoded; host is injected from config/registry
